decision.title: Live from Glastonbury (A BBC Recording)
tracklist: Friday I'm in Love (with Robert Smith)

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (20 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_from_Glastonbury_(A_BBC_Recording), https://www.discogs.com/release/35852119-Olivia-Rodrigo-Live-From-Glastonbury-A-BBC-Recording. Live album capturing her Glastonbury 2025 Pyramid Stage headline set. Released December 5, 2025. 20 tracks. Includes two Cure covers performed with Robert Smith ('Friday I'm in Love', 'Just Like Heaven'); proceeds from those tracks donated to Doctors Without Borders.
